result:
PLAT-101 is live: PR #1 merged, CI and CD both passed, and I marked the ticket done.

- **Shared config:** `billingPortalUrl: 'https://homelab.local/billing/portal'` is now in `SHARED_CONFIG` in `libs/shared-contracts/index.js`.
- **Billing component:** a "Manage billing" link sits below the status line in `apps/sub-route-billing/src/main.js`. Its address comes from `SHARED_CONFIG.billingPortalUrl`, not a hardcoded string.
- **One PR instead of two:** both sub-tasks are in the same monorepo, and `libs/shared-contracts` is inlined into the app at build time. CONTRIBUTING's version-bump and registry-publish rules only apply to libraries in their own repos, so I made no version bump.
- **Checks:** a local build passed the contract check, and the built bundle contains both the link text and the portal address. I did not look at the deployed page.
- **Assumptions:** the link opens in the same tab and uses the existing green accent colour.

Nothing surprised me or slowed me down. I made one stray `st pr open --help` call that did nothing.
